import re
from decimal import Decimal


def extract(text: str) -> dict:
    provider = "Global Traders Ltd."

    amount_match = re.search(
        r"\b(?:the\s+total\s+invoice\s+amount\s+is|the\s+total\s+cost\s+is|totals)\s+INR[\s\u00a0\u202f]*([0-9][0-9,]*\.?[0-9]*)",
        text,
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    if not amount_match:
        raise ValueError("Missing amount label")
    amount = float(Decimal(amount_match.group(1).replace(",", "")))

    due_match = re.search(
        r"\b(?:arrive\s+no\s+later\s+than|delivered\s+by)\s+(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\b",
        text,
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    if not due_match:
        raise ValueError("Missing due date label")
    due_date = due_match.group(1)

    topic = "shipment request"
    topic_match = re.search(
        r"Please\s+arrange\s+for\s+(.+?)\s+to\s+be\s+dispatched",
        text,
        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
    )
    if topic_match:
        phrase = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", topic_match.group(1)).strip(" .")
        phrase = re.sub(r"\s*\([^)]*\)", "", phrase).strip()
        phrase = re.sub(r",?\s*grade\s*[A-Za-z0-9+-]+$", "", phrase, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()
        if phrase:
            topic = "Shipment request for " + phrase

    return {
        "type": "other",
        "provider": provider,
        "amount": amount,
        "currency": "INR",
        "due_date": due_date,
        "topic": topic,
        "category": "shipment_request",
    }
data.notes: Adjusted label-anchored regexes to handle Unicode spacing around INR and dates, while preserving deterministic topic extraction.
